models.composition: Spring, or Homage to Jean Goujon
models.qualification: Exact Gulbenkian limestone group, inventory 2333, not a replica. Museum confirms after 1919, France, limestone, dimensions 220 × 235 × 129 cm and original hair polychromy. Strong textured public thumbnail. Tall group: native front/above/reverse required, especially heads and rear.

City brochure confirms specific Pont Gisèle Halimi example. 1935 is composition date, not verified date of this cast. Bristol Museums confirms adult wife Georgette as model. Listing GLB83.2MB, zero texture maps; verify source vertex colors/materials and complete crown/reverse in native preflight.

models.composition: Monument to the Pioneers of Aviation (Toulouse stone version)
models.qualification: Exact Toulouse stone aviation memorial with billowing drapery, not the separate lead/bronze L’Air edition. Orsay scholarly inventory identifies 1939 Toulouse stone version, and Orsay exhibition chronology gives 1948 installation. Current site placement identified by source and corroborating relocation account. Use Stone, not source’s uncorroborated marble specificity. Public GLB55MB has zero texture maps; native preflight must confirm faithful physical capture and intact raised hand, feet, drapery/reverse.

Exact marble installed Parc Montsouris1910, signed/date1906; Orsay scholarly field inventory confirms identity and ownership. Textured27.8MB public GLB; scanner explicitly describes189-photo photogrammetry. Scholarly2025field check notes right hand and left great toe missing from injured worker; inspect source independently to establish condition at capture, do not excuse capture holes as historic damage.

Municipal2012–2014tourism guide hosted by local Lycée Victor Duruy names L’Offrande1937 at Pont Gisèle Halimi; Boulogne-Billancourt museum teaching dossier documents1936plaster. Therefore retain1936–1937composition and unknown casting date. ListingGLB96.7MB, zero texture maps. Native front/above/reverse must verify head, fingers, extended feet and source color/materials. No AI reconstruction claimed by this model page; publisher’s mixed inventory makes native confirmation essential.

Museum-published capture of the specific Touchstones marble. The largest provider thumbnail shows the complete adult female figure and base, with a narrow irregular fringe around the underside. Native front, above and reverse preflight must confirm crown, quiver, fingers and base coverage. The provider presentation has a glossy material appearance; preserve the source material and compare with museum photographs before publication.

Photographic capture by Thomas Flynn (nebulousflynn) of the Écija museum sculpture. Largest provider thumbnail reviewed: figure, raised right arm and supporting column are retained. Native preflight must examine upper hair, raised elbow and reverse. Museum record identifies small missing finger fragments as physical losses. Preserve surviving photographic color.

Photogrammetric capture by SyntaX (syntaxcg), identified by the publisher as Bouchardon’s Louvre sculpture. Publisher reports a cleaned, decimated mesh with texture reprojection from a high-resolution capture. Largest thumbnail inspected: complete adult reclining figure, limbs and rocky seat retained. Native front, above and reverse preflight must verify the crown, raised arm and underside without inferring that mesh cleanup establishes complete capture.

Official Giravolt capture by Pol Guiu, La Tempesta, with text supplied by the Museu d’Història de Sabadell. Largest provider thumbnail inspected: surviving adult female torso, wheat bundle and partial upper legs are retained. It is a documented torso, not a complete figure; native preflight must confirm all fracture surfaces and reverse capture.

Official Museu de Badalona publication, model by Yiting Tan. Largest provider thumbnail inspected: mature muscular upper torso and historical fracture surfaces are present with detailed photographic marble color. Native preflight must confirm reverse, neck and underside. This is a historical fragment, not an incomplete capture of a standing figure.

Public thumbnail shows mature seated anatomy and a thin sculpted veil. The thumbnail has a photographic cemetery backdrop; native intake must determine whether surrounding geometry is included. Exact tomb location, material and title are source-backed. Native crown/reverse and boundary inspection required.

Official library-published sculpture scan; public front thumbnail complete and detailed. It is a wall relief, so do not require an invented full back. Public listing reports 268.8 MB and 7.84 million faces; authenticate actual GLB size and respect intake bounds. Reject if heavy source cannot meet current serving workflow without unwanted alteration.

Official museum-published textured scan; bare adult torso, complete seated figure in actual thumbnail. Museum record expressly calls the subject a mother goddess. No composition or accession match in catalog. Public GLB listing 152.3 MB is not authenticated source size.

Exact model directly embedded by official TASA page. Catalogue PDF page 18 / printed page 17 visually matches sculpture and confirms artist, date, material and measurements. Actual thumbnail shows mature female anatomy. Gray patches on body and irregular crown need prompt native front/above/reverse checks; do not repair missing capture. Bronze-colored surface is tinted plaster, not bronze.

Exact model directly embedded by official TASA page. Catalogue PDF page 34 / printed page 33 visually matches the same bronze torso, round pedestal and truncated composition; confirms artist,1990,bronze,29×15×10 cm. Mature adult anatomical torso in thumbnail. Native top/reverse review still required.

Public thumbnail shows all three mature figures, arms, miniature ship and base. The scan publisher identifies this as a low-polygon version with 2K textures. Heads have visible texture blotches; native inspection must exclude major loss before selection. Official Hamburg park guide confirms1912,Arthur Bock,shell limestone and exact three-city subject.
